title: My Day [Kids Vocab] Daily Routine ⏰ From Morning to Night Words
speaker: English Singsing
zh: 【English Singsing】我的一天 [兒童詞彙] 每日例行公事 ⏰ 從早到晚的單字（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: English Singsing My Day
cues.en: English Singsing My Day
cues.zh: 英語唱我的一天

cues.text: Wake up!
cues.en: Wake up!
cues.zh: 醒醒吧！

cues.text: get up get up I get up at 7:00.
cues.en: get up get up I get up at 7:00.
cues.zh: 起床 起床 我7:00起床。

cues.text: have breakfast have breakfast I have breakfast.
cues.en: have breakfast have breakfast I have breakfast.
cues.zh: 吃早餐 吃早餐 我吃早餐。

cues.text: brush my teeth brush my teeth I brush my teeth.
cues.en: brush my teeth brush my teeth I brush my teeth.
cues.zh: 刷牙 刷牙 我刷牙。

cues.text: wash my face wash my face I wash my face.
cues.en: wash my face wash my face I wash my face.
cues.zh: 洗臉洗臉我洗臉。

cues.text: get dressed get dressed I get dressed.
cues.en: get dressed get dressed I get dressed.
cues.zh: 穿好衣服，穿好衣服，我穿好衣服。

cues.text: Hurry up!
cues.en: Hurry up!
cues.zh: 趕快！

cues.text: go to school go to school I go to school.
cues.en: go to school go to school I go to school.
cues.zh: 去學校去學校我去學校。

cues.text: take classes take classes I take classes at school.
cues.en: take classes take classes I take classes at school.
cues.zh: 上課 上課 我在學校上課。

cues.text: have lunch have lunch I have lunch at the cafeteria.
cues.en: have lunch have lunch I have lunch at the cafeteria.
cues.zh: 吃午餐 吃午餐 我在自助餐廳吃午餐。

cues.text: play with friends play with friends I play with my friends.
cues.en: play with friends play with friends I play with my friends.
cues.zh: 和朋友一起玩 和朋友一起玩 我和我的朋友一起玩。

cues.text: come home I come home.
cues.en: come home I come home.
cues.zh: 回家吧我回家了。

cues.text: come home do my homework
cues.en: come home do my homework
cues.zh: 回家做作業

cues.text: do my homework I do my homework.
cues.en: do my homework I do my homework.
cues.zh: 做我的作業 我做我的作業。

cues.text: have dinner have dinner I have dinner.
cues.en: have dinner have dinner I have dinner.
cues.zh: 吃晚餐 吃晚餐 我吃晚餐。

cues.text: take a shower take a shower I take a shower.
cues.en: take a shower take a shower I take a shower.
cues.zh: 洗澡 洗澡 我洗澡。

cues.text: go to bed go to bed I go to bed.
cues.en: go to bed go to bed I go to bed.
cues.zh: 去睡覺去睡覺我去睡覺。

cues.text: Good night!
cues.en: Good night!
cues.zh: 晚安！

cues.text: review
cues.en: review
cues.zh: 審查
